items.title: MRNA ($$): Feb $230 calls bought

items.title: VST ($$$): Jan $87.50 puts sold
items.summary: 5,500 January 2027 $87.50 puts sold to open at $0.79 on 11/24, following 8,700 Dec 24 weekly $95 short puts on 11/23 and 14,600 March $85 short puts on 11/5; a 600 February $135 call buy at $8.62 on 11/23; spot $121.30. Shares -24.8% YTD, lost 50/200-day in late October but held above the 11/5 low; 50-day near $140 resistance, support at the November low near $111. Desk lean: sell puts under the November low as the entry. $$$ Featured.

items.title: Desk market wrap 11/25
items.summary: Stocks opened sharply lower on fresh tariff threats and a tech-rally stall (VIX ~31), SPY sold off hard early then recovered nearly all of it; solar was the standout group and breadth flipped positive midday as the VIX fell. Trend still lower with SPY below the 8- and 21-day. S&P resistance 7,330 / support 6,970. Semis leaders AMD, SMTC, MU, ALAB, AMAT saw large long-dated puts sold to open into the selloff. Markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving; Friday half-session.

items.title: ICE ($$): Jan 2029 $130 calls bought
items.summary: A stock-replacement buyer took 375 January 2029 $130 in-the-money calls at $62.08 (about $2.3M), plus 275 January 2029 $150 calls at $48.41 on 11/24; spot $174.90. Shares have closed above the 50-day every session since 10/29 and sit 3.6% under the 11/12 high near $181, with the 21-day EMA near $171 as first support. Desk lean is the long-dated call as a stock substitute; $$ Featured, not the $$$ list.

items.title: GEN ($$$): May 2027 $37 calls bought
items.summary: 3,500 May 2027 $37 calls bought at $1.80 on 11/24, adding to an unusual 4,000 April 2027 $35 calls bought at $1.55 on 11/18 (open interest 6,831 at that strike); spot $30.00. Shares are up about 10% YTD and have held above the 50-day and 21-day EMA for 19 straight sessions, 5.4% under the September high. Valuation sits near the low end of its 10-year range into a raised outlook; a close through the September high is the breakout trigger.

items.title: Desk market wrap 11/24
items.summary: Stocks faded as the Nvidia relief rally lost momentum and a report of new tariffs on China and the EU weighed; semis were hit hard as money rotated out of AI, while biotech, pharma and retail led. Breadth improved into the afternoon with IWM and the Dow turning green. S&P resistance 7,330 / 7,500, support 6,970 / 6,830. GDP, PCE and durable goods are due before the holiday. Size puts sold in MU, TSM, AMD, ADI; calls bought in CCCC, MRNA, BMRN.

items.title: TYL ($$): Mar $410 puts sold
items.summary: 100 March 2027 $410 puts sold to open at $33.52 on 11/18 (open interest 151), plus about 200 March 2027 $450 calls bought at $29.83 on 11/12 and 400 March 2027 $380 calls bought at $20.65 on 10/9; spot $406.70. Shares are down about 10.4% YTD but have held above the 200-day since 10/13, sitting between the 8- and 21-day EMAs with the 50-day near $370 as support and $437 the upside target. items.title: CAH ($$): Jun $220 puts sold

items.title: Desk market wrap 11/23
items.summary: Tech led a sharp rebound as Asian authorities moved to support markets; semis were the standout and the VIX fell back under 30. The S&P stays below its 200-day, with resistance 7,330 and support 6,970. Size calls bought in ENTG, LRCX, MRVL, ARM; puts sold to open in WMT, TGT, BURL.

items.title: TJX ($$$): Dec $140 puts sold
items.summary: 3,000 December $140 puts sold at $7.85 on 11/11, 5,100 December $120 short puts opened at $1.04 (open interest now 6,022), December $140 put open interest 4,570; 2,000 December $145 calls bought at $2 still holding (3,307); spot $139.60. Shares are down about 9.1% YTD, rebounded off the September low, and are back above the 50-day. Desk lean agrees with the put sellers as a way to own the name into the holiday quarter and the February report.

items.title: CHTR ($$): Dec $145 calls bought

items.title: Desk market wrap 11/20
items.summary: Heavy selling Friday as the S&P broke below 7,000 to new lows and the VIX moved back above 30. Rotation out of tech into housing, staples, and insurance, with bonds bid.

items.title: CELH ($$$): Sep 2027 $47.50/$65 call spreads bought
items.summary: 50,000 September 2027 $47.50/$65 call spreads bought on 8/6 and still in open interest, alongside 7,000 June $35/$32.50 short strangles and more than 5,000 January $35 puts sold; spot $30.88. Energy drink leader sold off Thursday after tagging the 200-day, down about 33% YTD. Desk lean is that the name can work higher in 2027 on new product launches and international upside.

items.title: TEL ($$$): Feb $230 calls bought
